Heather Haddon / Wall Street Journal :

 Sources: DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire Instacart, and the deal could be completed as soon as this week   —  Deal could be completed as soon as this week, people familiar with the matter say  —  DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire food-delivery rival Instacart , according to people familiar with the matter.
